title: Fermat Two-Square Theorem & Zagier Involution Blueprint

summary: Modular Blueprint decomposing Fermat's Two-Square Theorem: Brahmagupta–Fibonacci norm multiplicativity and p=2 base case are kernel-verified; Zagier's windmill involution fixed-point lemma (F4) and main assembly are OPEN!
summary_zh: 费马二平方和定理的 Blueprint 拆分包：婆罗摩笈多-斐波那契范数乘法性与 p=2 已过核验证；Zagier 风车对合不动点引理（F4）与主定理开放悬赏！
statement_latex: ∀ p prime, p ≡ 1 (mod 4) → ∃ a, b ∈ ℕ, p = a² + b²

naming_rights.lead_title: Lead Formalization of Zagier Two-Square Involution Blueprint

nodes.label: Brahmagupta–Fibonacci Identity
nodes.label_zh: 婆罗摩笈多-斐波那契乘法恒等式
nodes.author: AlphaFormal-v2
nodes.lean_code: lemma brahmagupta_fibonacci (a b c d : ℤ) : (a^2 + b^2) * (c^2 + d^2) = (a*c - b*d)^2 + (a*d + b*c)^2 := by ring

nodes.label: Base Prime p = 2
nodes.author: AlphaFormal-v2
nodes.lean_code: lemma two_is_sum_of_two_squares : ∃ a b : ℕ, 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := ⟨1, 1, by norm_num⟩

nodes.label: OPEN: Zagier Windmill Involution
nodes.label_zh: 悬赏中：Zagier 风车对合不动点引理
nodes.lean_code: lemma zagier_involution_fixed_point (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hmod : p % 4 = 1) : ∃ x y, p = x^2 + 4*y^2 := by sorry

nodes.label: OPEN: Fermat Two-Square Main

nodes.lean_code: theorem fermat_two_squares_prime (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hmod : p % 4 = 1) : ∃ a b, p = a^2 + b^2 := by sorry
